input.sql:
SELECT a.#{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_smart_list","line":"379db98d","path":["columns","partner_key"]}')} as partner_key,
       a.#{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_smart_list","line":"379db98d","path":["columns","affiliate_id"]}')} as affiliate_id,
       pm.#{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_smart_list","line":"e17681ad","path":["columns","affiliate_member_id"]}')} as affiliate_member_id
FROM #{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_smart_list","line":"379db98d","path":["list_name"]}')} a  JOIN #{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_smart_list","line":"e17681ad","path":["list_name"]}')} pm
ON a.#{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_smart_list","line":"379db98d","path":["columns","partner_key"]}')} = pm.#{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_smart_list","line":"e17681ad","path":["columns","partner_key"]}')}
